_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); personal-computer and consumer-electronics signals

pit_profile.why: Apple: it 'designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services', and is 'the only authorized maker of hardware using macOS, which has a minority market share in the personal computer market' (its own FY2017 10-K, which gives no store count: 463 in the FY2015 10-K); its products and services 'compete in highly competitive global markets characterized by aggressive price competition and resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Apple: it 'designs and develops nearly the entire solution for its products, including the hardware, operating system, numerous software applications and related services', and is 'the only authorized maker of hardware using macOS, which has a minority market share in the personal computer market' (its own FY2017 10-K, which gives no store count: 463 in the FY2015 10-K); its products and services 'compete in highly competitive global markets characterized by aggressive price competition and resulting downward pressure on gross margins': a margin risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 23.12x; +145% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.96; conservative 2yr -26%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.0%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +18.1%/yr (Q4 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +28.4%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +74.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AAPL (retrospective, 2018-09-28) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 23.12x (64.1% downside to Bear $81 / +2.8% upside to Bull $232) | Adj composite 2.13 vs market 3.09: gap -0.96 [OVERVALUED] | +145% above the EPP floor $92 (10x FY18E $9.21) | Conservative 2-yr case: -25.9% total (-12.9%/yr) | At 24.5x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $299 sits above the BULL case; Mac units -13.3% in Q3 FY18, forward net sales +14.1-17.9% (Q4 FY18 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
